claims.claim: Direct drive emel industrial sewing machine
claims.evidence: Witness only shows a close-up of the machine body/base with marking “EM81”; no full view or label confirming brand/model type (direct drive/industrial) and no parts shown (motor/drive system).
No country-of-origin marking is visible in the provided close-up.
No power-on/test-run footage; only a static close-up.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: No accessories or manual are shown in the witness report.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: No service history documentation or internal inspection is shown.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or may not stitch properly (motor/drive, timing, feed, tension issues).
risks.proof: A short video of the machine powering on and performing a straight stitch on fabric, showing feed and consistent stitch formation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-tested sewing machine (worst case: may need repair).

risks.risk: Missing critical parts (bobbin case/bobbin(s), foot pedal, power cable, presser feet/attachments).
risks.proof: A laid-out photo/video showing every included accessory: foot pedal, power cable, bobbin case, bobbins, presser feet/attachments, and any manual.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown bundle (worst case: buyer must source missing parts).

risks.risk: Needle area/feed/presser foot condition may be worn or damaged (bent needle bar, worn feed dogs, missing presser foot).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle area, feed dogs, and presser foot from multiple angles, plus a stitch test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially worn/needs servicing around the needle/feed system.

risks.risk: Body condition may include cracks, stripped screws, or damage not visible in the close-up.
risks.proof: Full front/side/back photos of the entire machine body and base, including underside if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average used condition based only on the limited close-up.

risks.risk: Model/brand identification may be incorrect (the visible marking “EM81” may not match the seller’s claimed brand/type).
risks.proof: Photo of the machine’s full nameplate/label (brand, model, voltage) and any serial number sticker.
risks.if_unproven: Price based on the visible marking only, treating claimed specs as unconfirmed.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the full machine (front, side, back) showing brand/model plate and any serial number.
Send a video of a full test run: power on, stitch a straight line on fabric, and show the foot pedal/controls working.
Show close-ups of the needle area, feed dogs, and presser foot(s).
Lay out and photograph every included accessory: bobbin case, bobbins, foot pedal, power cable, and any presser feet/attachments.
Provide a photo of the manual (cover page) and any label indicating country of origin.
response.reason: The witness can identify the machine marking “EM81” from a close-up, but key functional and completeness details are not shown; pricing should assume the worst-case (non-tested/incomplete) until proof is provided.
